name: Shenzhen Energy Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Energy Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese entity primarily involved in the production of electricity. Its operations encompass a diverse portfolio of power generation facilities, including those leveraging low-carbon technologies, natural gas, wind, solar (photovoltaic), and hydroelectric sources, among other clean energy solutions. The group also engages in the distribution of gas and provides solid waste treatment services. Established in 1991, the company was previously known as Shenzhen Energy Investment Co., Ltd. before officially adopting its current name in April 2008. Its corporate headquarters are located in Shenzhen, China.
